newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba has no comment on talk it checking DM prices.
newsitem.headline: Buba has no comment on talk it checking DM prices.

text.p: The Bundesbank declined to comment on Tuesday on market speculation that it was checking mark prices in the foreign exchange market.
"We are not commenting on this," a spokesman said in a response to a Reuter enquiry.
Currency dealers said the Bundesbank was checking mark prices earlier, but actions could not be confirmed.
A Frankfurt-based dealer also said there was no indication of Bundesbank intervention and attributed the dollar's slip against the mark to comments from Finance Minister Theo Waigel.
Waigel said earlier on Tuesday he believed the dollar and the pound's strength against the mark was an overreaction.
He added that Germany stood by previous agreements on foreign exchange rates within the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations and was in contact with its partners.
The dollar fell to 1.7855/65 marks at 0740 GMT from just under 1.79 marks before Waigel's comments. Waigel made his comments just after 0700 GMT.
